pull_request.title: fix(lints): reduce false positives in RedundantEnvClone pass
pull_request.body:
##closes #90 
## Overview
Fixes false positives in the `RedundantEnvClone` lint pass (`soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs`). Previously, the lint flagged every `.clone()` on `soroban_sdk::Env` without checking if the clone was required for ownership or lifetime reasons (such as moves into closures, struct bindings, or by-value calls where the original binding remains in use).

The lint now performs usage/borrow analysis so it only fires when a reference or the original binding could be used directly, preventing non-compiling remediation advice.

## Changes Included
- **Usage Analysis**: Updated `RedundantEnvClone` in `soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs` using `clippy_utils` analysis helpers to verify if the cloned `Env` is strictly required for surrounding code to compile.
- **Closure & Lifetime Moves**: Excluded clones that move `Env` into closures, store it in longer-lived structs, or pass it by value when the local variable is used later in scope.
- **UI Test Fixtures**: Added non-flagged test cases alongside existing flagged cases in `soroban_cost_lints/ui/main.rs`.
- **Documentation**: Documented remaining known edge cases under `docs/lints/`.

## Diagnostic Output (Before / After)

### Before
```text
error: redundant clone of `soroban_sdk::Env`
  --> soroban_cost_lints/ui/main.rs:24:20
   |
24 |     let closure = move || env.clone();
   |                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ help: pass Env by reference or value instead of cloning

commits.message:
docs: add guide on handling false positives

- Create docs/false_positives.md covering:
  - Definition and known false positive patterns per lint
  - Three suppression methods: #[allow], .lintignore, budget.toml
  - How to evaluate and report false positives
  - Verification of suppression in tests
- Update docs/SUMMARY.md with new guide entry
- Update README.md suppression section to reference the guide
- Add batch_write_different_keys test fixture demonstrating
  realistic false-positive suppression scenario
fix: update stderr line numbers after adding batch_write_different_keys test fixture

fix(redundant_env_clone): skip lint when clone is needed for compilation

Add two guards to RedundantEnvClone::check_expr:
- Skip if the receiver has reference layers (&Env, &mut Env) — clone
  produces an owned Env from a borrow.
- Skip if the original Env binding is used again after the clone — both
  original and clone are live.

When the receiver isn't a simple local binding (e.g. field access),
the lint conservatively skips.

Update UI test fixtures and stderr to cover the new non-flagged cases.
Document known false positives in the lint reference page.

fix: correct stderr whitespace for Symbol::new warning entries

The UI test framework does exact byte-level comparison. Three lines in
the Symbol::new sections had 4-space indent before '|' instead of the
expected 3-space indent, causing cargo test to exit 101.
